player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa da {difficulty} RushHour wuyar warwarewa. Slide motoci don 'yantar da ja mota [X] kuma fitar da shi daga gefen dama. Ayyuka: [A+], [B-], da dai sauransu. (+ = gaba, - = baya).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aiki mara inganci. Yi amfani da tsari [A+] / [B-].

game_message.solved: Motar ja ta yi nisa! Ka warware matsalar.
